verdict.rationale: Benchmark documents its own public API, which covers contact search, list CRUD, campaign setup and duplication, report retrieval, read-only domain status, and scoped API keys with per-resource permissions and expiry. However, the docs say the user must open a duplicated campaign in the Benchmark UI to make final edits and send it, so the API cannot drive the full send flow, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: API-driven campaign sending and editing, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), write access for domains, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create, rename, duplicate, merge, and delete lists from another system.
Set up the campaign name, subject line, sender details, and recipient list via the API.
Duplicate a previous campaign via the API to inherit its design, then open it in Benchmark to make final edits and send.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
Search contacts by email, custom field, list, status, or creation date.
